_readme: The only source of business facts for blog posts. If something isn't here, don't state it. Prices stay out of posts until Gab adds confirmed ones to 'prices'. Items under 'check_with_gab' must not be stated as fact.

business.name: MobilePitStop - Valeting & Detailing
business.type: Mobile car valeting and detailing, plus garage-based work at a unit in Birkenhead
business.positioning: A detailer, not a car wash. Explain the method and why it matters. Never present the service as a quick wash.
business.mobile: Comes to the customer's home or workplace, roughly within 20 miles of Ellesmere Port
business.reviews: 5.0 stars on Google (say 'five-star rated on Google'; don't quote a review count, it changes)
business.booking: Online: pick a service, answer a few questions about the car, then book. Garage services are by quote.
business.honesty_line: Send a few photos in daylight and we'll tell you straight which service the car needs, including when a cheaper one will do.

services.name: Maintenance Wash
services.for: Keeping an already-clean car clean between deep cleans. Not a first clean for a neglected car.
method: snow foam pre-wash so dirt is lifted before anything touches the paint
two-bucket safe hand wash with grit guards
wheels, tyres and arches cleaned
hand dried with plush microfibre
interior blow out, vacuum and key areas wiped
glass cleaned inside and out

services.name: Interior Deep Clean
services.for: Interiors that need more than a vacuum: grit, stains, sticky surfaces, kids, pets.
method: compressed air through seat rails, joins and vents
deep vacuum of seats, carpets, mats, boot and edges
steam cleaning of contact areas
steering wheel sanitised
crevices, seams and vents agitated by hand
plastics scrubbed to a natural satin finish, not greased
interior glass cleaned

services.name: Exterior Detail
services.for: Paint that's dirty in a way washing doesn't fix: tar, iron fallout from brake dust, road film.
method: snow foam pre-wash and two-bucket hand wash
wheels, tyres and arches deep cleaned
trims, door shuts and badges detailed
chemical decontamination of tar, iron fallout and road film
hand dried, water traps cleared
protection applied to finish
add_ons: clay bar decontamination (the step machine polishing needs first)

services.name: In & Out Deep Clean
services.for: The full reset inside and out. The right first clean for a car that hasn't been properly done in months.
method: everything in the Exterior Detail
everything in the Interior Deep Clean
steam, shampoo and extraction of seats, carpets, mats and boot, included rather than sold as an extra
seat stain treatment included
a protection wax on the paint
services.upgrade: Can be upgraded with a 6-month ceramic sealant, which makes it a Protection Detail

services.name: Protection Detail
services.for: A deep clean plus proper paint protection. Protects the paint you've got rather than correcting it.
method: everything in the In & Out Deep Clean
clay bar decontamination so the paint is glass-smooth
6-month ceramic sealant on the paint
Glaco hydrophobic coating on the glass
add_ons: paint enhancement (1-stage machine polish) before the protection goes on
longer-life ceramic coatings in place of the sealant, by quote

services.name: Machine Polishing (Enhancement Polish, 1 stage)
services.for: Paint that looks dull, hazy or swirled under direct light.
method: wash, chemical decontamination and clay bar first
trims and badges masked
single-stage machine polish across all paint panels
removes most light swirls, water marks and light scratches (never promise all of them)
finish checked under an inspection light
protection applied afterwards

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.for: Long-term protection. A coating locks in whatever condition the paint is in, so the paint is corrected first.
method: full decontamination and clay bar
machine polish first
ceramic coating on the paint
Glaco on the glass
aftercare guidance
services.notes: Coatings are booked by quote because application depends on the weather. Longer-life options exist; don't state durations beyond 'longer-life options'.

services.name: Odour Removal (cigarette, milk, pet, bio)
services.for: Smells that come back: smoke, spilt milk, pets, vomit and other biological spills.
method: treatment chosen to match the odour
source removal by steam, shampoo and extraction
ozone or chlorine dioxide treatment where suitable
ventilation treated, not just surfaces
cabin air filter advice so it doesn't return
services.key_point: Air fresheners mask odour. This removes what's causing it.

services.name: Detailing Maintenance Plan
services.for: Regular visits that keep a deep-cleaned or protected car at that standard, at a lower price per visit.

services.name: Paint Correction (2-stage and multi-stage)
services.for: Paint you want as close to perfect as possible. Done at the unit, by quote.
method: cutting stage for deeper defects
refinement stage to remove haze and restore gloss
a third stage for badly neglected paint
two days or more depending on condition

services.name: Window Tinting
services.for: Heat and UV rejection and privacy. Fitted indoors by a specialist, by quote.
services.law: UK law: the windscreen must let through at least 75% of light and the front side windows at least 70%, so those can only be tinted lightly. Windows behind the driver are unrestricted.

services.name: Paint Protection Film (PPF)
services.for: Clear self-healing film on the panels that take stone chips. By quote.

services.name: Vinyl Wrap and De-chrome
services.for: Colour changes, partial wraps and chrome trim wrapped black. Reversible. By quote.
